title: Eligibility Checker
prompt: Implement `eligible(age, income, has_job)` returning `true` only when: age is at least 18, AND (income >= 2000 OR has_job). Age exactly 18 counts; 17 does not.

tests.name: adult with job
tests.hint: 18 counts as adult; having a job alone qualifies.

tests.name: minor rejected
tests.hint: Under 18 never qualifies, even with income and a job.

tests.name: adult nothing rejected
tests.hint: No job and income below 2000 must fail.
